subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR be allowed to land as a classifier-only fix, or must it implement the compact-then-failover terminal behavior requested in the active review before merge?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the choice changes fallback routing, provider/model behavior, and session compaction semantics for existing users with configured fallbacks; the active maintainer review has not been cleared.

options.title: Require compact-then-failover before merge
options.body: Keep the Anthropic classifier but make exhausted overflow recovery produce a replay-safe fallback signal and prove both compaction and next-model selection.

options.title: Accept classifier-only scope
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept that this provider body becomes compaction-only for now and leave broader fallback behavior to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986.

options.title: Pause until canonical fallback work lands
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want the generic context-overflow fallback design to land first.

recommendation.title: Require compact-then-failover before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the Anthropic classifier but make exhausted overflow recovery produce a replay-safe fallback signal and prove both compaction and next-model selection.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the active assignee and reviewer who requested the compact-then-failover terminal contract.
